interfaceDescription: The options to apply on the Excel export.

escapeFormulas.description: If true, text cells starting with =, +, - or @ are escaped so Excel does not evaluate them as formulas.

fileName.description: The name of the file without the extension.

includeFormattedValues.description: If true, a formatted* column is added next to each value, using the series valueFormatter.

includeHeaders.description: If true, a header row is written on each sheet.

includeHiddenSeries.description: If true, series and items hidden through the legend are exported.
